description: This file provides Windows-specific functions for process execution, including command line argument escaping, command line composition and decomposition, and process attribute list management.

classes.name: ProcThreadAttributeListContainer
classes.description: A container managing Windows process thread attribute list resources, allowing updates and cleanup.

methods.name: EscapeArg
methods.description: Rewrites a command line argument with proper escaping for Windows.

methods.name: ComposeCommandLine
methods.description: Constructs a Windows command line string from arguments, escaping as needed.

methods.name: DecomposeCommandLine
methods.description: Splits a command line string into arguments, handling escaping and quoting.

methods.name: CommandLineToArgv
methods.description: Parses a Unicode command line string into arguments, returning a pointer to an array of argument strings.

methods.name: CloseOnExec
methods.description: Sets a handle to be non-inheritable, closing it on exec.

methods.name: FullPath
methods.description: Retrieves the full path of a specified file.

methods.name: NewProcThreadAttributeList
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new process thread attribute list.
